freshness.reason: The governed publication is within its operating target.

definitions.delayed: More whole minutes late than the selected 5, 10, 15 or 30-minute policy threshold at a commercial passenger stop in the region.
definitions.observedTrain: One passenger train per region with at least one commercial stop; a train crossing regions is counted once in each region.
definitions.score: Threshold-adjusted disruption score (0 best, 100 worst): 45% selected-threshold delayed share, 25% severe-delay share, 20% cancellation share and 10% average positive delay capped at 30 minutes.

sampleSupport.rationale: One hundred measurements cap the worst-case 95% Wilson half-width below 10 points and match the observed rolling-seven-day 10th percentile of 102.
